answers.q: What artwork should I supply for regular slotted carton?
answers.a: Preferred formats: AI, PDF, EPS; Accepted formats: PSD, PNG, JPG (300 DPI min); Color mode: CMYK preferred; Bleed: 0.125 in. on all sides; Safe zone: 0.125 in. from all edges. For a replacement graphic or shaped package, confirm the matching template before laying out the design.

answers.q: How is my configuration priced and reviewed?
answers.a: This product is priced by quote. Choose the available options and provide your dimensions, quantity and artwork needs so pricing and production timing can be confirmed before production.

answers.q: What should I share to start a custom packaging project?
answers.a: Share the product dimensions, desired packaging structure, quantity and finish ideas. Include how the product will fit inside and any inserts or assembly needs.

answers.q: Do I need a finished dieline?
answers.a: You can start with your own dieline or describe the structure you need. The consultation helps establish the dimensions and structure before final print artwork.

answers.q: Can I discuss finishes before choosing a box?
answers.a: Yes. Include the finish ideas you are considering, such as soft-touch laminate, spot UV, foil or embossing. The appropriate material and finish combination is confirmed for the project.

answers.q: Can I upload references for the consultation?
answers.a: The consultation form accepts project details and reference files. Include drawings, artwork or packaging examples that explain the direction you want.

answers.q: Is the consultation a checkout or confirmed order?
answers.a: No. It starts a project discussion. Structure, materials, quantity, pricing and timing need to be confirmed for your packaging before production.

answers.q: How do I specify a custom-shaped mylar bag?
